batting.name: AC Gilchrist
batting.dismissal: c MK Tiwary b SP Narine

batting.name: Mandeep Singh
batting.dismissal: c RN ten Doeschate b Shakib Al Hasan

batting.name: P Dogra
batting.dismissal: c DB Das b R Bhatia

batting.name: Bipul Sharma
batting.dismissal: c MS Bisla b SP Narine

batting.name: AD Mascarenhas
batting.dismissal: c MS Bisla b R Bhatia

batting.name: Harmeet Singh
batting.dismissal: c MS Bisla b SP Narine

batting.name: JH Kallis
batting.dismissal: c P Dogra b BA Bhatt

balls.text: well, well, No 11 Bhatt has carted Narine over wide long on, down the track, the offbreak spun, but he connected off a big swing, and Punjab have something to bowl at
tossed up offbreak which is patted back by a stunned-looking Bhatt
that has to be one of the most bizarre dismissals, Harmeet has walked outside off, and scooped Narine into the keeper's gloves, Narine has five, he has been nearly unplayable today
Harmeet is getting them away from Punjab, he wanted to swing Narine over midwicket, but the delivery straightened, and the outside edge beat short third man
looks to slog him over long on, but it turns away from him and beats him
hat-trick ball, he punches the turning offbreak towards point
turned through square leg for a couple
that is a very fine strike, Harmeet making a lot of room outside leg, picking up the full ball from middle and drills it high over extra cover
inside edge goes past short fine leg as Harmeet has a slog
full ball pushed down to long off for one
slogs this one past midwicket for a couple
they have some pace, after an age spent dealing with slower ones and flicked legbreaks, Chawla gets front leg out of the way and swings a length ball over the bowler's head

PK is gone first ball, it was the flicked delivery that turns away from the right-hander, tossed up back of a length on middle, straightening and bouncing, PK had no clue about it and pushed inside the line to lose his bails

they keep falling, Narine gets another one, big turning offspinner again, tossed up on a length outside leg stump, and spits across him as he pushes forward, a thin edge to the keeper and he walks back immediately
massive turn, pitching miles outside leg stump, and turning across the left-hander, no chance of playing that one
pushed wide of extra cover
punched to sweeper cover
big backlift but he has to guide the slow length ball in front of point in the end, almost a run out, would have been one had there been a direct hit at the striker's end

Punjab have no answers against Bhatia, they can't get him away at all, and he has struck twice this over, Mascarenhas caught on the crease looking to push at a length ball that bounces, and he ends up feathering it to the keeper
slowly coming on to the pads from a length, dropped in front of square
it's difficult to get power on the big shots off these really slow slower ones on a slow pitch, Dogra looking to go down the ground, ends up hitting it weakly to long on
pushes another one close to the blockhole down to long off
close to the blockhole, good control from Bhatia, Bipul digs it back from around middle
dabs a slow back of a length ball past the keeper to short third man
now this one falls in the vacant midwicket region, he was looking to swing it down the ground, it came on slowly and he skied it off the inner part of the blade
this one was mistimed alright, he reached out to loft a length ball, scooped it towards long off in the end
runs it  behind point with an open face
that looked like a mishit but it carried comfortably over long off, Bipul went forward and lifted a full delivery in the air, timed it better than it looked like when he hit it
dabs a widish back of a length ball to point, there was width available, but he did not go after it
worked off the pads to deep midwicket
straightish length ball on leg stump, cannot do anything but pat it towards the bowler
thickish edge runs wide of short third man as looks to cut, Yusuf lumbers to his left to stop it
turns a slow loopy delivery to midwicket
pushed straight to point off the front foot

mix-up, confusion, and Punjab have lost the big wicket of Hussey, Dogra dropped it towards point and took a few steps out of the crease, Hussey responded and was already half way up the crease when Dogra stopped, seeing the fielder get to the ball, the throw came in to Bhatia, who was a mile away from the stumps, he managed to get the bails off in the end, and Hussey was caught inches short, Hussey storms off, he was done in there by his partner
this one will go, Shakib tossing it up too full, Hussey had the chance to get under it, he also made a bit of room and carted it high over long off
nudged behind square leg, and they come back for the second
goes for the sweep, misses as the length ball turns away after being angled in full, missed the off stump by inches, Shakib cannot believe it
pushed off the front foot towards cover, they go for the single, quite close in the end, direct hit would have been still closer
now this one skids on around off, punched through cover
slowly tossed up on leg, played out to midwicket
that beats him as it holds its line from a good length outside off stump, some bounce too
turns a full one from middle and leg to midwicket
worked behind square leg with the angle
goes back to hit a length ball down the ground, it comes slowly off the pitch, and he cannot get it past Bhatia
pushed through point
Mandeep has found deep midwicket with precision, got down on the knee for the slog-sweep, but hit it straight to Tendo on the rope
tossed up ball dips around off, pushed to short extra cover
driven wide of long off
comes down the track, Shakib shortens the length, and he only manages to push it away
slow through the air, swung wide of long on
backs away to one on middle and punches past extra cover
Mandeep stays in the crease and pushes a full toss in the air, he timed that well once more, but Tendo was quick to get around it at wide long off
turned to deep midwicket
full toss whipped through midwicket, long on runs to his right and cuts off the four with a tumbling stop
another slower one, with the angle on middle and leg, swung away to short fine
slower one arrives from Bhatia, but they have got two off this one, it was just a soft push that looped up in the air towards midwicket
sliced straight to point, when they found timing, they lost the placement
that was timed well again, but he placed it straight to short third man, again creating a bit of space outside leg, and using the bowler's pace with a dab
Mandeep looks to loft over extra cover, does not get the placement right as he makes some room outside leg, on the bounce to long off running to his left
suddenly they are timing them, a pleasing push past the bowler for a single now

non-striker makes it just in time for the second, pushed wide of sweeper cover  by Hussey, even if there had been a chance at the non-striker's end, there was no one to collect the throw, Unadkat was in the middle of the pitch
down to third man off a thick edge
the best shot of the day so far, Mandeep makes slight room, gets front leg out of the way, and times a length ball past short extra cover, beats sweeper cover easily to his right

there have not been many that have been timed today, this one was, seemed just a push in the air as Hussey came forward to one that straightened on off, Shakib could not get to it to his right, it even beat long-on's dive
gets bat in front of pad to nudge wide of square leg
has another go at a full delivery, gets it along the ground to long on
comes down the track but cannot do more than push it back to Shakib
plays a tossed up length ball from the crease and pushes it on the off side
mistimes a slog wide of long on, gets a couple still
135.6 kph good length delivery skidding across Mandeep, he tries to dab it to third man but misses
keeping a tad low this time, worked against the angle from around off through square leg
edged, but he was pushing softly at this pitched up ball as he opened the face, and it bounced in front and to the right of the keeper, he could not stop it
hops in the crease and turns a back of a length ball through square leg
gets it right this time, angles it across the right-hander on a good length, pushed past point
poor line to start off, short, on the pads, and pulled very comfortably over short fine leg
tries to scoop him over the off-side infield, but gets it straight down to long off
another inside edge, to deep midwicket, he was playing for the turn, looking to drive through extra cover
fires it in full, a lot more angle on this one, inside edge pops up in the air wide of midwicket
drives a full delivery to sweeper cover
full on off, pushed back to the bowler
angled in full from wide of the crease, nudged square on the leg side
close to the blockhole around middle and leg, he gets bat down in time to turn it towards midwicket
makes room to go hard down the ground, but finds no timing on the stroke, the ball rolls away to mid off
rides the bounce on this back of a length ball as he arches back, but guides it straight to point
skiddy length ball in to the pads with the angle, dropped towards midwicket for one
drives a pitched up ball straight to cover on the edge of the circle
whips a full delivery back down the pitch, bowler gets a hand to it, and takes the pace off it
gets forward and across, the offbreak spins in sharply, and pops up in the air behind square
quickish one fired in back of a length, punched wide of extra cover
offbreak turning in from a good length, punched to mid off
fullish ball turned wide of mid on for a single

he's gone through Marsh, another huge blow from Narine, it is the one that turns in to the left-hander, call it the knuckle ball or flicked ball or whatever, tossed up around middle and off, draws him forward, he pushes at the original line, but it spins back in to go through the gate
pushed off the front foot towards short third man
worked off the pad through square
tight stuff from Kallis, around off on a length, pushed to point from the crease
mistimes as he looks to cross-bat through midwicket, they take a single as the ball rolls away in front of square
misses the flick off the pad
follows him as he makes room outside leg, Mandeep manages to get it behind square leg
tries to guide this length ball but mistimes it to point
that one turned alright, difficult one for the left-hander, as it spun sharply away from him as he pushed at it
straightish one down the leg side

Narine has struck in his first over, Gilchrist grimaces as soon as he realises he has top-edged the attempted swing over midwicket, the off break from Narine did not turn much, it bounced just around off, and Gilchrist ended up hitting it straight and high, cover settled under it
appeal for lbw, as he pushes forward, struck just outside the line of off with a tossed up offbreak
dabs an offbreak on the off side and takes off, is sent back  by Gilchrist
swings a full delivery down the ground, mid on scrambles to his right and gets down just in time to stop it
starts off with a tossed up very full one, which is dug out towards covers
Mandeep has a go at the slower length ball, does not quite time it, but ends up dragging it between midwicket and mid on
turned wide of midwicket for a single
skiddy back of a length ball played out to midwicket
run-out chance missed, ten Doeschate was quickly onto the ball as he ran in from midwicket, the dive would not have saved Mandeep had the lob from a diving Tendo hit
short of a length again and into Mandeep, who stays in the crease and blocks
short of a length and on to the pads, tucked away to deep backward square
Gilchrist survives, that inside edge could have gone on to the stumps, instead, it sneaks past them to short fine, he was playing for some turn there, there wasn't any
shortish, but it came on quickly, and he adjusted to drop it towards point
this one is in the slot, flighted a shade, fullish, outside off, and he picks it neatly over midwicket
softly dabbed away to short third man from around off stump
short, too short, but Gilchrist's pull finds deep midwicket, on the bounce
skidding on towards middle from a length, played out on the leg side

cannot get it away, the legbreaks, those harmless looking legbreaks from a medium-pacer have done it for Punjab, tries to swing one of them over midwicket, cannot time it at all, it rolls away to deep midwicket
Bhatia gets a taste of how it feels to generate some power off slower ones, gets it towards long off, another pick-up fluffed, but they are satisfied with one this time
down the track, hits it down the ground, long on runs in, stops the ball, seems to have kept them to one, but he cannot pick it up cleanly, they hesitate and eventually get across for the second

he's bowled Tendo., the legbreak appears innocuous, but it has taken out Tendo, who looked to swipe it through midwicket from outside off stump, an inside edge results, also finds its way on to the stumps
cannot get this one away for more than a single down to long off
legbreak arrives on a length on leg stump, Tendo has already swung around to swing it behind square leg, but somehow misses it
excellent stuff from PK, for the third time in succession, he finds the blockhole, this time bang on middle, not much Tendo can do with that, just manages to jam down his bat on it
another one around the blockhole just outside off, dug out to short mid on
makes room, PK finds the blockhole around off, Tendo reaches out and squeezes it to point
swings hard and gets the full ball through midwicket
down to long on again for one
mistimes a swing off a length ball down to long on along the ground
and again, this time he tries to pull a short of a length ball, misses as it nips in a shade, the ball goes over the stumps, Gilchrist cannot collect it standing up, and KKR inch closer
tries to lift a length ball down the ground, is beaten by the bounce, which is why the ball also goes over off stump
worked through midwicket
steered to point, Tendo wants the single, has to dive back into his ground as the throw comes in
Das doing it for KKR, fetches the full ball from outside off and smokes it high to the left of long on
hits a low full toss quite well in the end, Marsh dives to his left at long on as the ball travels quickly down the ground
down to long off for a single
consecutive fours, full delivery clipped through midwicket with the angle, and just beats deep midwicket and long in running across to the rope
that has been forehanded past the bowler, no chance for long off, back of a length ball sitting up outside off, and Das smacked it hard
hits a full delivery down to long on
only legbreaks at the moment from Harmeet, worked through midwicket
tries to pull a bouncing legbreak, but it runs off the toe end towards short third
eased past the non-striker to long on
nudges a length ball from middle and leg through square
down the track and takes it on the full to push to long on
worked off the pad, deep midwicket runs in and keeps them to one, Mandeep it is
driven to deep point
pushed off the front foot down the pitch
full toss given, and accepted with a simple swipe over the bowler's head

Shakib has thrown it away, goes for another slow sweep after escaping the previous delivery, it is another googly from Chawla, Shakib was playing for the turn into him, top-edge swirled high and Chawla took it
balls.dismissal: Shakib Al Hasan — caught and bowled

balls.text: down to long on
another one could have gone, Shakib trying to slog-sweep but it flew on the bounce to long on, was the googly
flighted ball dips on him, he reaches forward and pushes it down to long on
flicked away to deep midwicket
swipes it away behind square off the pad
worked to deep midwicket
length ball turned on to the leg side for one
flashed away to deep point
non-striker wants the single, it has been pushed straight to short extra cover, he has to get back
defended carefully
pushes forward, inside edge dribbles square on the leg side

Punjab edge ahead now, what a fightback from them, Chawla takes out Yusuf, who tries an awkward paddle sweep and is bowled, tossed up legbreak on leg stump, Yusuf reaches out, but somehow misses the ball, it just brushed his gloves, and carried on to hit the stumps
defends a flighted ball outside off solidly
shout for lbw, but Yusuf was struck outside the line of off on the forward push

Punjab are back in this, Bisla departs now, Chawla flighting it up for the drive, Bisla goes for it, thinking it will spin away, but the ball does not turn, carries in with the angle and takes out middle stump
down the track and clipped to deep midwicket
swept away to deep square

that has beaten everyone, superb delivery, flighted to lure Shakib forward into a big drive, it dips, turns in, and bounces just over the stumps, keeper can't collect it, Bhatt cannot believe that has not hit the stumps
shuffles across and nudges with the turn from middle on the leg side
KKR have lost their third wicket, they had gone into a bit of a shell lately, Bhatt tossed it up, Tiwary pushed for the turn, the ball carried in with the angle to strike him in front, gone
pushes a flighted ball to extra cover
that came in, he was looking to run it towards third man, but took it on the pads in the end, was outside the line of off though
fetches it from way outside off stump and tries to sweep it, mistimed to short fine leg
tossed up outside off, hammered down to long off
that has gone through him, tossed up delivery beats him as he ends up driving outside the line
opens the face and pushes the legbreak in the gap past cover
drives off the front foot straight to extra cover
another legbreak, on the pads and turned behind square
legbreak from Harmeet, pushed softly down the pitch
opens the face and runs it straight to short third man
slower one from the back of the hand, with the angle down leg, rolls away towards square leg
dabs a slower one to short third man
widish ball cut hard to sweeper cover
pushed towards vacant midwicket, and by the time the men from the deep reach the ball, they have run two
drives a full ball down to long off
yet another sweep attempted, from well outside off, and he misses, looked to be the one that slides on straightish
sweeps a tossed up ball to deep square leg
goes for the sweep, does not quite time it, down to fine leg
drops a length ball in front of cover for one
back of a length ball defended tightly down the track
reaches out and pushes to point
well done, again some width offered, he waited and steered it behind point and wide of third man
bit of width, slapped away to sweeper cover from the crease
pushes a length ball down to long off
worked in front of square leg
off the pads close to the pitch on the leg side
length ball pushed down to long on
nudged behind square leg
paddles a tossed up ball from off stump to fine leg
whips a straightening length ball from middle wide of midwicket
tightly defends another one on off stump
gets forward and drives a pitched up ball to mid off
defended off the front foot to cover
backs away outside leg again, but cannot time the shot through extra cover this time, punches it down to mid off in the end
too full, too much on the pads, flicked behind square leg, Mandeep gets around to it in the deep with a big dive
makes room and hammers a length ball from off over cover
gets it right this time, as he finds the blockhole on leg stump, squeezed out towards point
another one swings in full and down leg, just not working for PK at the moment
full delivery driven past midwicket for a couple
hurls it full and down the leg side
drives a pitched up ball well, but straight to the bowler
opens the face and runs it to third man
down the track and slams the length ball, Hussey at extra cover dives to his right to save the boundary
worked behind square leg with the angle
PK cannot stop the ball with an awkward dive at short fine leg, it was flicked well off the pads
turns a length ball from middle and leg in front of square
straight to the bowler, Gautam pushes the length ball going across him, does not bother to keep it down, right to Mascarenhas in his followthrough
angles the length ball in, flicked away off the pad to deep midwicket
Bisla goes over mid off and over the rope, stands outside leg stump and dispatches the length ball with a clean swing
drops a length ball in front of cover and takes off for a single
pushed to extra cover
pushes a length delivery to extra cover
guided towards backward point
Gautam ensuring KKR make the most of these restrictions, PK swings it in from outside leg, he watches it closely and flicks him over square leg
runs it away towards the man around gully
another four, with the keeper standing up, Gautam stays in the crease and dabs a length ball from just around off stump past short third man
what a blinder from Dogra, incredible take at cover, Kallis had made room to a tossed up ball and smoked it in the air, Dogra put in a big dive to his left at cover and caught it one-handed
defends a tossed up full delivery on middle
again he comes out of the crease, takes a flighted ball on the half volley and turns it through midwicket
a push through midwicket now earns him two more
deftly done, again he advances out, Bhatt flights it even more, Gautam takes it on the full and clips it away, it goes between short fine and square leg
takes on a tossed up ball, down the track and drives it through extra cover
caught on the crease to a skiddy length ball ending on off, patted back to the bowler
lots of width outside off, Kallis cuts, Marsh dives at backward point, saves four
worked through square leg
makes room and guides to point
pushed on the off side
coming in from a good length, turned wide of mid on, direct hit would have been close
